ItemID: 1; Title: DiCUNO 100pcs Pre-Wired SMD Micro LED Diodes, Pre-soldered 0805 Mini Lights for DIY, Science Projects, Wire Length 6.3" (16cm), Red/Yellow/Green/Blue/UV/Pink/Orange/White/Chartreuse/Warm White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects center on mechanical fabrication and fastening; I have no miniature lighting project underway.
ItemID: 2; Title: Fuzion Calibration Weights 7 PCS, 1g 2g 5g 10g 20g Stainless Steel Scale Calibration Weight Kit, Calibration Weight with Storage Box, Tweezers for Digital Scale Gram Scale Balance; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have been buying measurement tools, but I have no current need to calibrate a small scale.
ItemID: 3; Title: TALLSOCNE Alligator Clips Electrical Test Leads，Full Insulation Car Battery Test Lead，for Multimeter Leads, 1000 V/Max 19A ，Jumper Wires Alligator Clips Length 39.37 inches (2 Pieces & 2 Colors）; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could help with electrical repairs, but my recent purchases do not suggest an immediate electrical testing task.
ItemID: 4; Title: Klein Tools TI222 Thermal Imager for iOS Devices, Thermal Imaging Camera, 10,800 Pixels, Three Color Palettes, High/Low Temperatures; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Thermal inspection interests me after buying an inspection camera and infrared thermometer, but I would check device compatibility and a specific use before choosing it.
ItemID: 5; Title: Cast Master Elite Crucible Tongs - 10kg Crucible Lifting Tongs - Heavy Duty Steel, Holding-Clamp Tongs for Melting Furnace - USA Designed & Supported; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My metalworking purchases involve drilling, cutting, and fastening, with no indication that I need furnace or casting equipment.
ItemID: 6; Title: Ruitool Pocket Hole Screws #8 x 1" Square Drive Coarse-Thread Zinc Coated Self-Tapping Wood Screws 150ct. for Woodworking Tools; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Wood screws fit my workshop interests, but I already bought a screw assortment and would wait until a project calls for pocket-hole fasteners.
ItemID: 7; Title: BOCEUC Multimeter Test Leads, Meter Needle Test Probe Adapter Set, Aligator Clips Electronic Test Lead kit Accessories(10 PCS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am currently more interested in fabrication supplies than expanding electrical diagnostic accessories.
ItemID: 8; Title: AUTOGEN 5 Gallon Vacuum Chamber Kit Tempered Glass Lid with 4 CFM Single Stage Vacuum Pump HVAC; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My epoxy work makes vacuum equipment interesting, but I would confirm resin compatibility and whether my projects justify the setup before choosing it.
ItemID: 9; Title: Akfix 610 Construction Adhesive Outdoor - Clear Polyurethane Wood Sealant for Floor, Ceramic, Tile, Concrete, Rubber, Metal, Marble, Waterproof Bathroom Adhesive | 3 Pack, 10.48 Oz.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for workshop repairs because bonding wood and metal fits my repeated interest in adhesives and fastening supplies.
ItemID: 10; Title: Vaxxen Labs U100 1mL 31G 1cc 5/16" (8mm) - Box of 100; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current use for these fine-needle syringes; buying dropper bottles does not establish a need for them.
